checklist.text: The whole patch from the room view is there, clear to the walls
Turn the ring all the way round: no hard edge, no corner line
Pan to the world's edge and look out: grass fades, nothing beyond
Rain inside reaches the mist and isn't thinner
Name tags fade with their birds in the mist
Draw ms inside with a full garden and with rain

description: Standing in the garden, the whole cube is clear and the ground carries on past the walls into a misty margin (`ObserverMargin` 1.0, in `ViewWindow.cs` and `hologram.fs`). Session 33. Known: birds out in the mist can't be clicked.
